title: Surreal Cosmic Landscape
description: A surreal alien landscape features rolling green hills under a starry night sky. Large colorful spheres and towering ring-shaped sculptures stand across misty hills, with a wooden pathway winding through the foreground.
prompt: Surreal alien landscape with rolling lush green hills and rocky cliffs under a starry cosmic sky filled with nebulae. Massive glossy spheres in vibrant green and red rest on the hills, while enormous colorful torus and ring sculptures in orange, red, and gold tower in the background. A wooden pathway winds through the misty terrain, with soft atmospheric fog between the forms, in a dreamy painterly style.
